items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC6 each covered by a test; spec-reviewer PASS.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing file, empty tail, unknown agent and placeholder-only reports all end in honest empty states; unknown agent: links render as text.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Markdown only (no raw HTML); agent: hrefs validated against the session's known agents; read-only GET of the existing validated transcript route.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real on-disk record shapes (coordinator message, delivered pointer), negative cases (ambiguous prefix, code spans, no provider) and a real-browser E2E through JSONL to DOM.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Feed derived once per fetched tail, memoised, windowed to the latest 200 events; no timers added.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New code in small cohesive files (all under 300 lines); MissionBody.tsx did not grow.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: Claude CLI subagent JSONL (incl. coordinator records, probed on real on-disk files); consumer: session-parser, reducer, FeedCard; E2E covers the chain.
